title: The MaoHaus / AntiStatics Architecture
materials: Ultra-high performance concrete perforated facade panels by Ductal®
summary_en: MaoHaus is an experimental facade intervention in a Beijing hutong that uses ultra-high-performance concrete and a calibrated field of apertures to reduce weight while producing a legible image effect, including a night-time portrait reading. ArchDaily explicitly frames the work as a synthesis of material properties, customized computational tooling, and generation, making it a fabrication-driven computational facade rather than a conventional house.
